4718103.title: Verify the merchant sees the ODP button on the homepage

4708423.title: Verify the Oke button on dialog success bottom sheet on the profile and settings page
steps_gherkin: Given The user has logged in as "single_outlet_owner"
And The user is on the profile page
When The user taps on the "Account and application section item 2"
And The user submits the "Biasa saja" sentiment feedback
And The user inputs "Feedback" in the "Feedback form dialog input field"
And The user taps on the "Feedback form dialog send button"
And The user taps on the "Oke" text
Then The user does not see the "Feedback form dialog"
And The user sees the "Profile page"
